ai-safety-leaders-physical-ai-safety-and.author: Luiza Jarovsky, PhD
ai-safety-leaders-physical-ai-safety-and.core: Posted in last 7 days AI Safety Leaders - Physical AI Safety & Zero-Trust Infrastructure 🚨 I recently sat down with Amit Goel, head of robotics ecosystem at Nvidia, to discuss the challenges of physical AI SAFETY and how companies can prepare for what lies ahead: He explained how Halos for Robotics works, broke down the new safety paradigm that should guide physical AI development, and outlined the safety layers that should be implemented to account for new risks and the unpredictability of the physical world. Amit also explained that agentic AI raises the level of risk and demands a “zero-trust” philosophy, along with robust external infrastructure to oversee and monitor the interaction between the agent and the physical system itself. He is much more optimistic than many of us in the field of AI governance, and he genuinely thinks that physical AI will soon be capable of handling the types of work that are dangerous, strenuous, unsanitary, or inconvenient, freeing humans to do what is truly meaningful to us This conversation took place during GTC Berlin (thank you, Nvidia, for inviting me), where I also interviewed Ali Golshan, one of the senior engineers leading the company's new Open Agent Safety Platform. [I'm looking to interview highly innovative leaders who are challenging existing paradigms and actively building the future of AI safety, ethics, and governance. preppers-in-berlin-practical-prepping-ti.core: Posted in last 7 days Preppers in Berlin - Practical Prepping Tips & Essentials Hey all, I'm looking to chat with any major preppers in this group for a media project I'm working on. The concept is often bucketed with conspiratorial thinking and generalised anxiety. Certainly there is some overlap, but having supplies for 72 hours or a bugout bag are also just good pragmatic tips for staying safe during a pandemic, a grocery store's refrigeration system going haywire, or other radical events. Via on-camera videos, I'd like to speak with subjects about their prepping tips, why they decided to formalize their prepping measures, and, ideally, show a little peek into their prepping essentials. The objective is to show that while eccentric corners exaggerate prepping to sometimes even more fearful extremes, prepping is also a very reasonable and pragmatic enterprise. If you or someone you know here in Berlin is interested in sharing your experience, I'd love to speak with you. I can be reached here, Signal at @liam_kelly.66, or via email at [email redacted].
